item.title: Phan defense seeks Teresa’s records tied to night of trooper’s fatal crash
item.description: LOWELL — The attorney for Billoeum Phan is asking a Middlesex Superior Court judge to order a restaurant and bar in Woburn to turn over surveillance video and business records from the date State Police Sgt. Scott Quigley allegedly drank before a fatal head‑on crash — evidence he says could reveal misconduct by law enforcement figures tied to the Phan brothers' murder case.
